item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi dz+wa nag dgra bgegs kun phung
item.coloph: de ltar dza nag las kyi byang bu 'di/ 'gro la sman phyir thugs kyis bskur (bskul) phyung ste/ rjes 'bangs rnams kyis gnyer bzhes thugs la 'chang*/ snyigs lnga'i dus ltas ban bon nub skabs/ d+ha ris bris te zhang zhung sgo yi phyogs/ zangs brag rir sbos/ srung mar bcos (bcol) bya/ phyis su sprul sku gcig gi rnyed par shog/ phyis su bdag 'dra gshen spral pas zangs brag ri mgul tsi ta 'dra ba'i brag ngos nas dngos grub rnyed te (de/)gsang rgya bsdoms/ slar hor sras mchog gis bkas bskul dang / ma zad las can grogs mched du ma'i ngo skal du shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
